SELECT * INTO BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS_BU_20231207 FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS

SELECT * INTO BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS_DELTA_BU_20231207 FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS_DELTA

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS_DELTA_BU_20231207










TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE;
INSERT INTO BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE SELECT * FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE_BU_20231204;

TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE_DELTA;
INSERT INTO BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE_DELTA SELECT * FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE_DELTA_BU_20231204;

SELECT TOP 10 * FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE



SELECT CORP_ID, BANK_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CORP_ID, BANK_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1


SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CORP_ID, BANK_ID ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
*   INTO BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE_WITH_DUP_20231207
FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE; --Target table to remove duplicate



SELECT CORP_ID, BANK_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.CRM_CORPORATE
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CORP_ID, BANK_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1
